description: Look up a named company's or fund's SEC Form D filing by the issuer's name — what it reported: total offering amount, amount sold, number of investors already invested, date of first sale, the federal exemption claimed (Rule 506(b), 506(c), Investment Company Act 3(c)(1)/3(c)(7)), securities offered and related persons. Pass the name, e.g. "YCA26, L.P." or "Chickadee Biomedicines"; SEC EDGAR full-text search covers every Form D on file (default the last 5 years), so the issuer's filing is found wherever it sits. Also finds filings naming an executive or fund. A Form D is a self-reported offering notice, not an independently verified closed round.

query.description: Issuer, person, fund, or filing text to search.

since.description: Start filing date YYYY-MM-DD. Default 5 years ago.

until.description: End filing date YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

name: form_d_search_issuers
title: Form D Search Issuers
